title: 臺鐵 CK124 蒸汽機車保存
summary: 以「臺鐵 CK124 蒸汽機車保存」為案例，逐步分析保存蒸汽機車的未加壓展示、狀態追溯與機構。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用；列車質量例題指一節虛擬車廂，非完整編組。
summaryEn: Use TRA CK124 steam-locomotive preservation to analyze Unpressurized display, condition traceability and mechanisms of a preserved steam locomotive. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces. Train mass examples concern one virtual car, not a full formation.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.title: 使用需求與試驗邊界｜臺鐵 CK124 蒸汽機車保存：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Use requirements and test boundary | TRA CK124 steam-locomotive preservation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 使用需求與試驗邊界｜臺鐵 CK124 蒸汽機車保存 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use requirements and test boundary | TRA CK124 steam-locomotive preservation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：保存蒸汽機車的未加壓展示、狀態追溯與機構。本單元觀察 保存紀錄、鍋爐外觀、連桿與輪對 中與「使用需求與試驗邊界」相關的介面。車型名稱不是試驗條件；先把乘員、貨物、續航與地形需求轉成載荷表。整車的輸入質量必須包含結構、能源系統及使用載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Unpressurized display, condition traceability and mechanisms of a preserved steam locomotive. In preservation records, boiler exterior, rods and wheelsets, inspect the interface related to “Use requirements and test boundary”. A vehicle name is not a test condition. Convert occupants, cargo, range and terrain needs into a load table; input mass must include structure, energy storage and operating payload.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 臺鐵 CK124 蒸汽機車保存 的原廠或實測規格。m_total=m_empty+m_payload；假設空車 42500 kg、載荷 7500 kg。 計算結果 = 50000 kg。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for TRA CK124 steam-locomotive preservation. m_total=m_empty+m_payload; assume empty mass 42500 kg and payload 7500 kg. Result = 50000 kg. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
steps.failureEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
steps.check: 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 保存紀錄、鍋爐外觀、連桿與輪對，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. Link evidence to this case’s preservation records, boiler exterior, rods and wheelsets; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

P_mech=η P_heat; assume teaching heat input 1e6 W and overall efficiency 0.08. Result = 80000 W. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 復原展示機構動作順暢不代表壓力邊界合格；材料、壁厚、裂紋及檢驗紀錄需獨立審查。
steps.failureEn: Smooth motion of a restored display mechanism does not establish pressure-boundary integrity; materials, thickness, cracks and inspection history require separate review.
steps.check: 分開化學能、蒸汽焓流與輪端功率的量測邊界；把凝結、排汽與機械摩擦列入未回收能量。 將證據連回本案例的 保存紀錄、鍋爐外觀、連桿與輪對，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Separate chemical energy, steam-enthalpy flow and wheel-power boundaries; identify condensation, exhaust and mechanical friction within unrecovered energy. Link evidence to this case’s preservation records, boiler exterior, rods and wheelsets; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

knowledge.textEn: Complete in a paper diagram, spreadsheet or separately prepared offline teaching model: Mark energy flow and losses on an unpressurized model and distinguish preservation/display evidence from operating evidence; do not operate a real boiler. Label the evidence c248, unit 2, input conditions and data version.
